column1: To 4 men for collecting iron sand, at 10 Fanams each for 4 months
To 6 men to make charcoal, 4 for the smelting-house, and 2 for the forge, during 8 months, at 8 Fanams monthly for each
To 4 labourers at the smelting-house, for 8 months, at 10 Fanams each
To 6 labourers in the forging-house, of whom 1 has 12 Fanams, the others 6 Fanams a month, for 8 months
To the government paid yearly; for making charcoal 60 Fanams, for ground rent for furnace 20 Fanams, for ditto for servants houses 20 Fanams
